description: Defines the ManufacturerDescription entity class, representing a manufacturer description with URL, click statistics, and link to Manufacturer, mapped to the MANUFACTURER_DESCRIPTION table in the SALESMANAGER schema.

classes.name: ManufacturerDescription
classes.description: JPA entity class representing a manufacturer description, includes fields for URL, click stats, and linkage to Manufacturer.

methods.name: getUrlClicked
methods.description: Returns the number of times the URL was clicked.

methods.name: setUrlClicked
methods.description: Sets the number of URL clicks.

methods.name: getDateLastClick
methods.description: Returns the date of the last click.

methods.name: setDateLastClick
methods.description: Sets the date of the last click.
